tips.text: Press Blood Frenzy only when an enemy is close enough to reach. Once it starts, Briar attacks the nearest enemy by herself and you can't steer her.
Recast Snack Attack during Blood Frenzy for a bite that heals you. It hits harder the lower the target's health is.
Use Head Rush on the enemy champion, not a minion. The leap stuns them and lowers their Armor and Magic Resist, so your follow-up attacks hit harder.
During Blood Frenzy, casting Head Rush on a minion makes Briar stop prioritizing champions. Aim it at the enemy champion when you want to fight them.
Hold Chilling Scream until it is fully charged and point it at a wall behind the enemy. The knockback then deals big damage and stuns them.
Chilling Scream also heals you and cuts the damage you take while you charge it, and enemies can't interrupt the charge. It is a good escape or heal in a trade.
Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy. Use it when you want to stop chasing and get out of a fight.
At level 6, aim Certain Death down a lane at a champion you can kill. It flies to the first champion it hits and the others nearby flee.
Fight when you are hurt. Crimson Curse heals Briar more the lower her health is, but she has no natural regeneration, so don't linger at low health.

combos.name: Frenzy cancel
combos.when: When Blood Frenzy would drag you into a bad spot, or you want control of your movement back.
combos.text: Casting the scream ends Blood Frenzy early, so you can walk again. The charge also gives damage reduction and healing while you reposition.

combos.name: Dash-cast Head Rush
combos.when: When you want to stun a target at the very start of a Blood Frenzy engage.
combos.text: Head Rush can be cast during the Blood Frenzy dash. This stuns the target almost instantly and resets your attack timer.

combos.name: Full-charge wall stun
combos.when: When an enemy stands with their back near a wall or terrain edge.
combos.text: Hold the scream for its full charge so it knocks enemies back. If they hit the wall they take big bonus damage and are stunned.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on the enemy champion you want to catch; the stun holds them for your follow-up attacks and the leap resets your attack timer.
Once you are in Blood Frenzy, you can't control who you hit or where you walk. Start it only when you are ready to commit to a fight.
Recast Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for a bigger bite on a low-health enemy; it also heals you.
Charge Chilling Scream to full near a wall and aim it so the enemy gets knocked into the wall; they take big damage and are stunned.
Use Chilling Scream to end a frenzy early when the fight turns bad. You also heal and take less damage while charging.
Chilling Scream leaves enemies slowed even without a full charge, so use it to stop someone from running away.
Fire Certain Death down a long line to hit an enemy champion from far away. Use it at level 6 to reach a target and then chase them down.
Hit several enemies with Certain Death in a team fight; the ones who aren't your prey flee, so you can focus your prey.
Hit as many things as you can; Crimson Curse bleeds stack on enemies and heal you, and you heal more the lower your health is.
Don't use Head Rush on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy unless you want to; she then stops prioritizing champions.

combos.name: Wall scream stun
combos.when: When an enemy stands with their back near a wall, such as in jungle corridors or against camp walls.
combos.text: Hold the scream for its full charge so it knocks back. An enemy who hits terrain takes big bonus damage and is stunned for longer.

combos.name: Frenzy cancel
combos.when: When Blood Frenzy locks you onto the wrong target or you need to take control of your movement back.
combos.text: Chilling Scream removes Blood Frenzy at once, so you can walk away or choose your own target. The charge also gives damage reduction and healing.

combos.name: Dash into Head Rush
combos.when: When opening a fight on a target within range of both leaps.
combos.text: Head Rush can be cast while the Blood Frenzy dash is still moving. Cast Q straight away to land the stun as you arrive.

tips.text: Use Blood Frenzy to jump onto an enemy champion when you can trade. It makes you chase the nearest enemy, so don't use it with several enemies close by.
Recast Snack Attack during Blood Frenzy to bite for extra damage and heal. The enemy's missing Health adds to the damage, so use it on a weakened target.
Head Rush stuns and lowers Armor and Magic Resist. Cast it on an enemy champion, not a minion, or your Blood Frenzy will stop focusing champions.
Fully charge Chilling Scream near a wall. The knockback makes enemies who hit the wall take big damage and get stunned.
Charge Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage while you are being hit. The charge can't be interrupted, but you can't move or attack during it.
Cast Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy early if you are chasing a target into danger.
At level 6, aim Certain Death down a long lane at an enemy champion. It can hit from far away and you fly to the first champion it hits.
Land Certain Death in the middle of the enemy team. Everyone but your prey flees, so you can chase your prey down.
Keep hitting enemies to stack bleeds from Crimson Curse. You heal from them, and you heal more when you are low on Health.

combos.name: Dash-cast Head Rush
combos.when: Engaging a champion and you want the stun to land as soon as you arrive.
combos.text: Head Rush can be cast during the Blood Frenzy dash. Press Q right after W instead of waiting to land, so the stun comes sooner.

combos.name: Scream to cancel frenzy
combos.when: You want out of the forced attacking, or need to heal and take less damage mid-fight.
combos.text: Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy and gives control back. Charge it to stop chasing and get the damage reduction and heal.

combos.name: Full-charge wall stun
combos.when: An enemy is standing with a wall just behind them in a narrow lane or jungle gap.
combos.text: Hold Chilling Scream for its full charge so it knocks back. An enemy who hits a wall takes big bonus damage and is stunned.

tips.text: Wait until Aatrox spends The Darkin Blade, then jump in with Head Rush; the enemy is stunned and can't dodge the next hit.
Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy, so use it to stop chasing when Aatrox is about to hit you with Infernal Chains.
Charge Chilling Scream fully with a wall behind Aatrox; the knockback then stuns him and deals big damage.
Aatrox heals when he hits you, so make fights short and burst him with Blood Frenzy's Snack Attack once he is low.
Use Certain Death to reach Aatrox when he is hurt; it finishes with him as your prey and gives you extra armor and magic resist.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush during the Blood Frenzy dash stuns Aatrox almost instantly, cutting off his Darkin Blade.
Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy early, letting her walk out of Aatrox's Darkin Blade line.

tips.text: Head Rush on Akali stuns her. Follow up right away, because she is weak once she cannot get away.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Akali is near a wall. The knockback stuns her and hurts a lot.
Akali can turn invisible in her smoke, but Blood Frenzy still makes you attack the nearest enemy. Use it to pin her down.
Use Certain Death to reach Akali when she runs. It marks her and you chase her until one of you dies.

comboRefs.note: Stunning at the start of the Blood Frenzy dash locks Akali down before she can use her dashes.

tips.text: Jump in with Head Rush to stun Ambessa, then trade while she can't act. Use it on her, not on a minion.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage when Ambessa is about to hit you with a big ability. It also ends Blood Frenzy.
Do not cast Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack carelessly; you can't steer while it lasts. Ambessa can slow you with Lacerate and punish you.
Fight her when her energy is low. Her abilities cost energy, so she has fewer tools to answer your all-in.
Keep Chilling Scream ready for her Public Execution; it can't stop the suppression, but the heal helps you survive the follow-up.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Ambessa almost instantly as Briar engages, before she can react with her dash.

tips.text: Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line, and dodge its detonation too; getting stunned by it leaves you open to a follow-up.
Jump on Anivia with Head Rush when Flash Frost is on cooldown; the stun stops her from running away and setting up her wall.
Anivia's Crystallize can block your path. Use Blood Frenzy to leap near her, or go around the wall.
Kill her egg when Rebirth triggers, so she can't come back. Certain Death helps you reach her and finish it.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Anivia almost instantly, so she has little time to answer the engage.

tips.text: Lead with Head Rush on Aurora; the stun keeps her from backing away with The Weirding, and you can start your fight while she is stunned.
Aurora turns invisible after Across the Veil, but Blood Frenzy still locks onto her, so you keep chasing her.
Use Chilling Scream at full charge with a wall behind Aurora; the knockback into the wall deals big damage and stuns her.
Aurora's rift from Between Worlds slows you when you touch its edge. Fight her inside it only if you can finish her fast.
Close in on Aurora while Twofold Hex is on cooldown. Her poke is what keeps you away.
Use Head Rush on Camille to stun her as she tries to trade. It also lowers her Armor and Magic Resist.
Take Camille's trade with Chilling Scream charged fully when she dives in; it cuts damage you take and heals you, and a wall hit stuns her.
Camille's Adaptive Defenses shield blocks only one damage type. Check which one it is and hit her with the other.
Stay away from Camille's Hookshot range when you are low. Her dash onto you stuns you, so keep minions or space between you.
Walk out of the smoke Rupture leaves on the ground before it lands; a knock up while Cho'Gath is near is dangerous for you.
Don't dash in with Blood Frenzy when Feral Scream is ready. Being silenced stops your Head Rush and Chilling Scream.
Trade early and stop Cho'Gath from eating minions and growing; the bigger he gets, the less you can burst him.
Fully charge Chilling Scream near a wall to knock Cho'Gath into it, which hurts him and stuns him.
Do not leap into Darius with Head Rush while Apprehend is ready; he can pull you back and punish you.
Use Chilling Scream fully charged with a wall behind Darius; the stun gives you time to hit him freely.
Poke Darius while Apprehend is on cooldown. Do not stay in his axe range or his Hemorrhage stacks will build up.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy when Darius has his slow ready, so you can walk away.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush during the dash stuns Darius almost instantly, which stops him from reacting.

tips.text: Do not rely on Head Rush as a stun on Dr. Mundo the first time; his passive resists it, so wait until it is used up before you use it to lock him down.
Step on the canister he drops to destroy it; he heals if he walks over it first.
Sidestep Infected Bonesaw; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of you can soak it.
Do not fight him while he is charging Heart Zapper; he stores damage and heals it back, so hold off until it ends.
Burst him quickly after Maximum Dosage starts, or back away until it ends; a long fight lets him heal through your damage.
Don't open with Head Rush when Fiora's Riposte is ready; she can parry the stun and stun you back.
Bait Riposte first with a weaker move, then engage once it is on cooldown.
Don't charge Chilling Scream toward a wall behind you if Fiora has Riposte up; a knock-back into terrain can get parried.
Fiora wins short trades with her Vitals, so use Snack Attack to heal back what you lose.
Jump on Gangplank with Head Rush when his Remove Scurvy is on cooldown. Otherwise he will cleanse the stun and fight back right away.
Stay away from his Powder Keg spots. A keg he blows up slows you and hurts a lot.
Chilling Scream charged fully knocks him back. If he hits a wall, he takes big damage and is stunned.
Respect his Cannon Barrage from level 6. It can hit you from anywhere on the map, so do not push low on health.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush stuns at the start of the engage, which can stop Gangplank from placing or shooting kegs.

tips.text: Leap in with Head Rush to stun Garen, then trade fast before he can use Decisive Strike.
Fight Garen when he has just been hit; Perseverance only heals him when he avoids damage for a while.
Do not trade into Garen at low health; Demacian Justice deals more damage the lower you are.
Charge Chilling Scream near a wall and knock Garen into it for a stun and big damage.
Hold Head Rush until Gnar steps forward to throw or last-hit. The stun lets you jump on him and fight.
Dodge Boomerang Throw by stepping to the side. It hits a thin line, and it slows you if it connects.
Fight away from walls, because Mega Gnar's GNAR! stuns you if it throws you into terrain.
When Gnar turns back from big to little, he can't gain Rage for a while. Go in on him then.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall to knock Gnar back into it. He takes big damage and is stunned.
Don't dive onto Gragas with Head Rush when Body Slam is ready. He can stun you and escape.
Stay out of Barrel Roll when it lands. Once you are in Blood Frenzy you can't control your movement, so the slow is hard to dodge.
Use a fully charged Chilling Scream to knock Gragas into a wall. It deals big damage and stuns him.
Hold Certain Death for when Gragas has used Body Slam. His escape is then on a long cooldown.
Walk up and use Head Rush on Gwen to stun her, then fight while she can't answer.
Don't jump in with Blood Frenzy while Hallowed Mist is up. You can't pick targets once frenzied, and Gwen is untargetable from outside the Mist.
Wait for Hallowed Mist to run out, then engage. Gwen has little defence once it is gone.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage while Gwen is hitting you. It also slows her.
Fully charge Chilling Scream with a wall behind Gwen to knock her into it and stun her.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush during the Blood Frenzy dash stuns Gwen almost instantly before she can set up her attacks.
A full-charge scream can stun Gwen against a wall, since she must stay close to use her empowered attacks.

tips.text: Wait out his grenade before you leap in with Head Rush. Its stun is what ruins your all-in.
Kill his turrets with the help of minions rather than diving into them alone. Blood Frenzy makes you stay on your target, so check for turrets before you leap.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage while his rockets hit you, then release it to slow him.
Go for the kill with Certain Death once his UPGRADE!!! is on cooldown, because he has few ways out then.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush during the Blood Frenzy dash stuns Heimerdinger almost instantly, cutting off his turret and grenade setup.

tips.text: Stay away from Illaoi's Tentacles when you trade; they slam hard and heal her. Fight where no terrain is close, or after killing them.
Use Head Rush to stun Illaoi, then hit her before she can swing Tentacle Smash. It also lowers her Armor and Magic Resist.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Illaoi is near a wall; she is knocked back and stunned if she hits it. It also heals you while you charge.
If Illaoi pulls your spirit with Test of Spirit, hit Illaoi and not the spirit. Hitting her shortens how long the spirit lasts.
Use Certain Death to reach Illaoi when she is away from her Tentacles. Her Tentacles are less of a threat in a quick fight.

comboRefs.note: Illaoi spawns Tentacles on nearby terrain, so a full-charge Scream knockback into a wall can stun and hurt her.
Casting Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy early, letting Briar walk out of a bad spot near Illaoi's Tentacles.

tips.text: Hold Chilling Scream for Irelia's dashes; it slows her and ends your Blood Frenzy, so use it when you need to stop being forced onto a target.
Don't burn Head Rush on Irelia while she charges Defiant Dance; she takes less damage and the charge can't be stopped.
Fight Irelia away from minion waves, where Bladesurge has nothing to dash to.
Dodge Flawless Duet; being stunned lets Irelia chain Bladesurge onto you, so stay out of the line between her blades.
Trade when Irelia's Ionian Fervor is down, since she has less attack speed and no bonus damage.
Do not run in with Blood Frenzy while Jax's Counter Strike is ready; you will be forced to attack him while he dodges everything and then stuns you.
Wait for Jax to spend Counter Strike, then jump on him with Head Rush.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy early if Jax is about to stun you. Fully charged near a wall, it stuns him.
Break his attack chain: Jax gets faster the longer he keeps hitting you, so fight in short bursts and do not trade for long.
Stay close to Jayce in the lane. He is far weaker when you are on top of him, so use Head Rush to stun him and force a trade.
Do not walk up to Jayce in a straight line in his Cannon Stance. Shock Blast hurts and he can use it as often as he likes while you approach.
Watch for Jayce's Thundering Blow; it roots you briefly then knocks you back, and he can use it to break your Blood Frenzy chase.
Use Chilling Scream charged to full against a wall behind Jayce; it knocks him back and stuns him for longer.
Jayce is strong early, so play safely and wait for your level 6 Certain Death to go after him.

comboRefs.note: Jayce's Thundering Blow knocks back, but a full-charge scream near a wall stuns and hurts him.

tips.text: Don't fight K'Sante when he has two stacks of Ntofo Strikes; the next one pulls and stuns you. Wait for the stacks to run out first.
Jump in with Head Rush when his Path Maker is on cooldown. It stuns him and cuts his Armor and Magic Resist, so you can trade freely.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy when you need to stop chasing. Charge it fully near a wall to knock him back and stun him.
Don't use Certain Death while he is All Out and you are low; he deals more damage then. Go in when All Out has run out.
Fight Kayle before level 6. She is a weak melee champion, so press her hard and put her behind.
Jump onto Kayle with Head Rush. It stuns her, and she is fragile.
Wait out Divine Judgment before you commit. It only makes the target invulnerable, so you can still stun them.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall when Kayle is close. The knockback can stun her.
Close in with Head Rush on Kennen so you stun him. Then hit him, since he is fragile and can't trade well up close.
Blood Frenzy makes you chase the nearest enemy, so use it only when Kennen is close. Otherwise you may run into poke or the wrong target.
Be ready for Kennen's Lightning Rush. It lets him slip away from your fight, so don't spend all your abilities before he uses it.
Step out of the way of Thundering Shuriken. Keep minions between you and Kennen so it hits them and not you.
Use Chilling Scream next to a wall so Kennen hits it and takes big damage and a long stun.
Use Head Rush on Kled to stun him, then fight while he can't act. Save it for when you can follow up with attacks.
Skaarl soaks the damage first, so trade and keep pressing until Kled drops off his mount, when he deals less damage to champions.
Don't stay near Kled once Bear Trap on a Rope hooks you. Fight away from him or break the tether before he yanks you in.
Chilling Scream charged fully knocks Kled back and stuns him if he hits a wall. Fight near walls to set that up.
Back off when Kled has Violent Tendencies ready, since his fourth hit hurts. Trade when it is on cooldown.
Don't fight Malphite while he has Granite Shield up; his Armor is much higher then. Chip the shield off first, then jump in.
Stay out of Seismic Shard range when you can. It slows you and speeds him up.
Don't start Blood Frenzy right before Ground Slam is ready. It cuts your Attack Speed, and you can't choose who to hit while it lasts.
Stun Malphite with Head Rush to start your trade, and hit him while he can't respond.

comboRefs.note: Full-charge scream knocks Malphite back, and a wall hit adds big bonus damage and a stun.

tips.text: Keep your distance from Mordekaiser once his Darkness Rise aura is up; his damage grows the longer you stay near him.
Do not fight Mordekaiser right after Realm of Death comes off cooldown. Save Certain Death for when he has used it, so you are not cut off alone.
Step out of the line of Death's Grasp; being pulled in leaves you stuck in his range.
Chilling Scream charged fully can knock him into a wall for a stun, so fight near terrain.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns almost instantly, which helps you open an engage on Mordekaiser.

tips.text: Walk up and use Head Rush when Naafiri steps forward to trade; the stun lets you land your attacks and Blood Frenzy.
Use Chilling Scream fully charged near a wall when Naafiri is next to it. The knockback hits hard and stuns her.
Start charging Chilling Scream when she dashes in to burst you. You take less damage and heal while it charges.
Use Blood Frenzy to lock onto Naafiri over her Packmates, since it prioritizes champions and your hits splash to those around the target.
Hold Certain Death for when she is low. Once you mark her, you chase her down even if she dashes away.

comboRefs.note: Ending Blood Frenzy early with the scream lets you walk back out of a bad spot when Naafiri's packmates pile on.

tips.text: Jump on Nasus with Head Rush when he is low on Mana or his Wither is down; the stun lets you hit him freely.
Trade early, before Siphoning Strike stacks make his hits heavy and before he has his ultimate.
Wither slows you and cuts your Attack Speed more over time, so end the fight quickly or leave once it lands.
Charge Chilling Scream fully with a wall behind Nasus for a big stun and damage.
Avoid fighting Nasus while Fury of the Sands is active; his aura hurts you during Blood Frenzy, so back off until it ends.
Do not start your fight when Olaf has his Ragnarok ready; Head Rush will not stun him through it.
Walk out of Undertow's line, and stay away from where the axe lands, since he gets it back to throw again.
Do not fight Olaf at low health; his Berserker Rage makes him hit faster and heal more the lower he gets.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall to knock him into it for a big stun, when he is not under Ragnarok.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is near. If he charges you into one with Searing Charge, you get knocked up and stunned.
Use Head Rush on Ornn to stun him, then hit him while he can't act. It also lowers his Armor and Magic Resist.
Sidestep Volcanic Rupture. Once you leap with Blood Frenzy you can't steer, so a slow from it can leave you stuck chasing him.
Do not run at Ornn right after Bellows Breath hits you. Brittle makes your crowd control last longer, so wait for it to fade.
Use Chilling Scream when you need to get out of Blood Frenzy. It heals you and cuts the damage you take while charging.
Do not leap into Pantheon while he braces Aegis Assault; it blocks damage from the front. Wait for it to end or go around behind him.
Stay out of his Comet Spear range when you are low, because it deals big damage to weak targets.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and slow him when he commits. Charge it fully near a wall for a long stun.
Land Head Rush on Pantheon first so he is stunned, then trade while his Shield Vault is on cooldown.
Use Chilling Scream to push Quinn into a wall when she Vaults at you. A full charge stuns her if she hits terrain.
Close the gap with Head Rush as soon as Quinn uses Vault or Blinding Assault. She has fewer escapes while they cool down.
Don't dash into Quinn when she's near a wall. Vault can take her over it and put her out of reach.
Hurt Quinn once she starts channeling Behind Enemy Lines. Damage removes her speed bonus for a while.

comboRefs.note: Full-charge Chilling Scream knocks Quinn back, and a wall hit adds damage and a stun.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Renekton to get a stun and shred his armor, then trade fast before he gets his Fury.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Renekton is near a wall; it knocks him back and stuns him for a long time.
Back off when his Fury is high, because his Ruthless Predator then stuns for much longer.
Leap in with Head Rush on Riven to stun her, then hit her while she cannot answer.
Wait for Riven to spend Ki Burst before you go in; once it is on cooldown she cannot stun you out of your leap.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Riven stands near a wall; the knockback stuns her if she hits it.
Chilling Scream slows Riven and heals you while you charge, so use it to reset a trade that went badly.
Build up the bleed from Crimson Curse by attacking Riven often; it heals you and punishes her for fighting.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Riven almost instantly, so Briar can start the fight before Riven reacts.

tips.text: Dodge Electro Harpoon before you dive in. It slows you and cuts your Magic Resist.
Dive in with Head Rush when Rumble is Overheating. He can't cast spells then, so he can't shield or slow you.
Head Rush stuns Rumble, so use it to stop him from casting Flamespitter on you in a trade.
Step out of The Equalizer's burning trail quickly. You can't steer while in Blood Frenzy, so avoid starting it where the trail will land.

comboRefs.note: Dash-casting Head Rush stuns Rumble almost instantly at the start of her Blood Frenzy engage.

tips.text: Trade with Head Rush when Sett has just spent Facebreaker; the stun lets you hit him for free.
Use Chilling Scream when you are about to be hit; it cuts damage you take and heals you while you charge.
Aim a fully charged Chilling Scream so Sett is knocked into a wall; he is stunned and takes big damage.
Do not fight Sett right after he has taken a lot of damage; Haymaker turns that damage into a shield and a heavy punch.
Use Certain Death on Sett only when you can finish the fight; Blood Frenzy keeps you attacking him, so you cannot walk away.
Cast Head Rush on Shen to stun him, then fight. Keep going while he is stunned.
Do not run into Shen's Shadow Dash; it taunts you, and you cannot walk away.
Spirit's Refuge blocks your basic attacks, so wait it out or fight something else while it is up.
Use a full Chilling Scream against a wall for a big knockback and stun, and it heals you while you charge.
Watch for Shen's Stand United after level 6; he can appear next to an ally mid-fight.
Do not chase Singed through his Poison Trail; leave when he runs and keep your health high.
Stay out of Mega Adhesive when you can; being Flung into it leaves you rooted and easy to hit.
Use Head Rush on Singed to stun him and cut his Armor and Magic Resist before you trade.
Cast Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy when Singed leads you into his poison, and heal as you charge.
Singed's Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail cut your healing, so avoid long fights while it lasts.
Stay out of Decimating Smash's long reach when Sion is charging; step out sideways rather than running straight back.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy and heal when Sion is about to hit you; it also slows him.
Jump in with Head Rush right after Sion has used Decimating Smash, while it is on cooldown.
Hit Sion's shield with your attacks and avoid staying close when Soul Furnace is about to blow up.
Use Chilling Scream at full charge to knock Tahm Kench into a wall. It stuns him and hurts a lot.
Hold Head Rush to stun Tahm Kench when he starts channeling Abyssal Dive. It interrupts him.
Stop fighting Tahm Kench once he has three stacks on you. Tongue Lash then stuns you and can set up Devour.
Wait for Tahm Kench to spend his Thick Skin shield, then trade hard. He gets no new stored health until it comes back.

comboRefs.note: Head Rush during the Blood Frenzy dash stuns almost instantly, giving Briar a fast engage start on Tahm.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Teemo to stun him, then fight while he cannot run; he is weak up close.
Watch for mushrooms in bushes and on your path; Noxious Trap slows you and reveals you. Hit them with attacks to clear them.
Expect Blinding Dart to make your attacks miss. Chilling Scream still works while you are blinded, so save it for the fight.
Use Certain Death at level 6 to reach Teemo from far away; he cannot easily run once you are marked on him.
Do not fight Tryndamere at low Health with Blood Frenzy active; Undying Rage lets him stay up and keep fighting while you are forced to attack him.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy early if the fight turns bad. You also heal while charging it.
Mocking Shout lowers your Attack Damage and slows you when you face away. Do not turn your back on Tryndamere to run.
Trade early with Head Rush while Tryndamere has little Fury, so he cannot heal with Bloodlust.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Tryndamere almost instantly at the start of the engage.

tips.text: Hold Head Rush until Urgot spends Disdain. Without his stun and shield he is much easier to jump on.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy if Urgot's Purge is shredding you. You also heal while you charge it.
Stay above low health around Urgot. Below a quarter health, Fear Beyond Death can drag you in and kill you.
Stay out of Corrosive Charge's blast area. Being slowed makes it easy for Urgot to catch you.
Wait until Varus has used Piercing Arrow, then leap in with Head Rush. The stun keeps him from kiting away.
Stay out of long Piercing Arrow range. Close the gap quickly with Head Rush or Blood Frenzy instead of walking up.
Chilling Scream, fully charged against a wall, can stun Varus. It also heals you a little and cuts the damage you take while you charge.
Hail of Arrows cuts your healing, so don't stand in it while trading.
Be careful when Varus has Chain of Corruption. A root from it can leave you stuck in Blood Frenzy and unable to escape.

comboRefs.note: A full-charge Chilling Scream into a wall stuns Varus, who is rooted or slowed by his own spells.

tips.text: Chase Vayne with Head Rush to stun her, then fight fast. She is fragile and has to work to escape.
Avoid fighting with a wall behind you. Condemn knocks you back into it for a stun.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall to knock Vayne back into it for a long stun.
Hit Vayne with Certain Death at level 6. Her Tumble cannot easily shake a chase.
Do not hit Vayne three times in a row if you can avoid it. Silver Bolts deals extra true damage on the third.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Vayne almost instantly at the start of a Blood Frenzy engage.

tips.text: Don't jump on Vladimir with Head Rush while Sanguine Pool is ready; he can dodge it and slow you in his pool.
Bait out Sanguine Pool, then go in. Once it is on cooldown, Vladimir has little way to escape your stun and burst.
Aim Chilling Scream so Vladimir is knocked into a wall at full charge. It deals huge damage and stuns him.
Kill Vladimir before Hemoplague finishes, or it heals him for each champion it hits.

comboRefs.note: Stunning at the start of the engage with Head Rush stops Vladimir before he can easily react.

tips.text: Do not fight Volibear when he has Thundering Smash ready. It gives him speed to catch you and a stun on his next attack.
Stun Volibear with Head Rush while his Thundering Smash is active. It ends early and he has to wait for it again.
Step out of the area of Sky Splitter when you see Volibear cast it. The lightning takes a moment to land, and it slows you.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and cut damage while you wait, and fully charge it near a wall to knock Volibear into it.
Hold Chilling Scream until Xin Zhao commits. It slows him, and charging it first gives you damage reduction and healing.
Stay out of Crescent Guard range at level 6. Xin Zhao's sweep knocks you back, and he takes no damage from enemies outside it.
Do not stay beside Xin Zhao for a long fight. Three Talon Strike ends with a knock up, and each hit lowers his other cooldowns.
Use Head Rush on Xin Zhao first, then trade while the stun lasts. His Audacious Charge can then follow you if you run.
Do not rely on Chilling Scream when Yasuo has Wind Wall ready, because the wall blocks it. Wait until the wall is gone.
Charge Chilling Scream fully with Yasuo's back to a wall. The knockback then slams him into it and stuns him.
Open with Head Rush on Yasuo so he is stunned. Then use Blood Frenzy and hit him while he cannot dash away.
Stay clear when Yasuo has two Steel Tempest stacks. His whirlwind knocks you up, and Last Breath can follow it.

comboRefs.note: A full-charge Chilling Scream knocks back, so Yasuo near a wall takes bonus damage and is stunned.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Yone to stun him, then fight while he can't hit back. Do it when his Mortal Steel is on cooldown.
Don't use Chilling Scream just to poke. Keep it for a full charge near a wall, where it stuns and hits very hard.
Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy. Use it to stop yourself chasing Yone into a bad fight, and heal while charging.
Yone can leave his body with Soul Unbound and snap back with stored damage. Don't chase him while he is in spirit form; he is about to return.

comboRefs.note: Stunning at the start of a Blood Frenzy dash gives Briar a quick stun to lock Yone down before he can respond.

tips.text: Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy early if Yorick walls you in with Dark Procession; it also heals you while you charge.
Kill Yorick's Mist Walkers quickly; they die to one attack, and thinning them out makes your trades with Yorick safer.
Stun Yorick with Head Rush when he commits to a trade, then fight while he cannot hit back.
Stay out of Mourning Mist; it slows you and lowers your Armor, which makes his Mist Walkers hit harder.
Do not run in with Certain Death while Yorick's Maiden of the Mist is out; she has lots of Health. Wait until she is gone.
Save Chilling Scream for when Zaahen commits to you; charged to full, it can knock him into a wall and stun him.
Use Head Rush on Zaahen to stun him, then fight while he can't hit back.
Trade early, before Cultivation of War stacks up. A long fight makes Zaahen's attacks hit much harder.
Don't count on the kill when Zaahen is low with Cultivation of War full; he can revive. Hold your damage or spells until he has used it.
Use Blood Frenzy to close the gap, then use Snack Attack to heal in a trade.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Zaahen right as Blood Frenzy starts, helping Briar start the fight.
A full-charge scream into a wall stuns Zaahen if he stands near terrain, even after he engages.

tips.text: Use Head Rush to stun Graves when you reach him; he cannot shoot or dodge while he is stunned.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall; it knocks Graves back and stuns him if he hits the wall.
Get out of Smoke Screen quickly; leaving the cloud removes its slow at once.
Use Certain Death on Graves once he has spent Quickdraw; you then jump to him wherever he runs.

comboRefs.note: Chilling Scream removes Blood Frenzy at once, letting her regain control and heal against Graves.

tips.text: Avoid standing between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike through it knocks you up.
Use Head Rush to stun Jarvan when he has no Golden Aegis shield up, then attack him while he is stunned.
Charge Chilling Scream fully if Jarvan is near a wall; the knockback into terrain deals big damage and stuns.
Chilling Scream is a good way to heal while Jarvan is closing in; it also ends Blood Frenzy, so use it deliberately.
Dodge Blade's Reach when you can; if Kayn never hits you, he cannot use Umbral Trespass on you.
Leap onto Kayn with Head Rush to stun him, especially when he is in the middle of a fight and cannot walk away.
Stun Kayn with Head Rush while he is in Shadow Step; hard crowd control ends it at once.
Watch for the warning at the edge of a wall; it shows Kayn is inside the terrain near you.
Stay near your minions and allies so Kha'Zix cannot hit you with Taste Their Fear at full strength.
Use Head Rush on Kha'Zix when he leaps in; the stun stops him from fighting back while you attack.
Fight Kha'Zix when Leap is on cooldown; he has little escape then.
Chilling Scream slows Kha'Zix and heals you while you charge it, so use it to survive his burst.
Hit by Certain Death, Kha'Zix can only run or fight you, so use it to catch him when he is alone.
Kindred is fragile, so pick her with Head Rush when you can reach her and stun her before she gets away.
Use Certain Death on Kindred when she is alone; the kick marks the first champion it hits, so make sure she is that one.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall when Kindred is close, so a knockback into it stuns her.
Watch for Kindred's Mounting Dread; it slows you, and her third attack on you brings a Wolf pounce, so end the fight before it lands.
Clear Kindred's Hunt camps in the jungle to slow her growth.
Chilling Scream ends your frenzy; use it when you need to heal or escape.
Do not fight Lee Sin at low Health; Resonating Strike deals more damage to a hurt target.
Stun Lee Sin with Head Rush when he commits to a dash or ability. It stops him chaining his combo.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Lee Sin has his back to a wall. The knockback and stun can win the fight.
Stay near allies when Lee Sin looks for Dragon's Rage. Briar's frenzy locks her movement, so a kick is hard to avoid.

comboRefs.note: Casting Head Rush mid-dash lands the stun quickly, before Lee can react with Safeguard.

tips.text: Stun Master Yi with Head Rush when he is not using Alpha Strike. He cannot be targeted while he vanishes, so wait for him to reappear.
Do not rely on Chilling Scream to slow Master Yi while Highlander is active; he is immune to slows then.
Hit Master Yi a few times so he has to spend mana on Meditate. Fully charge Chilling Scream against a wall for a long stun.
Use Head Rush on Naafiri to stun her, then fight. She cannot answer while stunned, and her armor and magic resist drop afterward.
Hold Chilling Scream for the full charge when Naafiri is near a wall; it knocks her into it for big damage and a long stun.
Do not rely on Blood Frenzy to chase Naafiri while she is untargetable; wait for her to reappear before committing.
Use Chilling Scream while charging to heal and take less damage when Naafiri dives in on you.

comboRefs.note: Cancelling Blood Frenzy with E lets Briar escape a bad target when Naafiri's packmates and dashes pull the fight.

tips.text: Don't open with Head Rush into a ready Nocturne; Shroud of Darkness blocks it. Bait the shield first with a different move.
Break Unspeakable Horror's tether by getting out of range, or you will be feared and chased down.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall to knock Nocturne back and stun him.
Watch for Nocturne's Paranoia darkening the map; stay near allies, since he can dash to you.
Wait out the Shroud of Darkness shield, then use Certain Death when it is down.
Hold Head Rush for Shyvana's approach; a stun on her breaks up her Emberstrike combo.
Wait out Inferno Aegis before you commit; her shield soaks your burst, so hit her once it is gone.
Use Chilling Scream when Shyvana is slowed or close. A full charge knocks her into a wall for a stun.
Don't fight Skarner with a wall behind you. Ixtal's Impact drags you into it and stuns you, so jump in from open ground.
Hold Head Rush to stun him if he charges at you. Ixtal's Impact ends when he is stunned.
Skarner's attacks stack up, so don't trade for long. Use Chilling Scream to heal and cut the damage you take.
Jump on Sylas with Head Rush to stun him, then fight while his Chain Lash and Abduct are held back.
Chilling Scream, fully charged, can knock Sylas into a wall for a long stun. Aim it so a wall is behind him.
Fight Sylas when he is hurt; Kingslayer heals him less when his health is high, so keep him low.
Charging Chilling Scream gives you damage reduction and healing. Use it to survive Sylas's burst, but it ends Blood Frenzy.
Hijack can copy Certain Death, so save your ultimate for when Sylas can't steal it, or he will use it on you.

comboRefs.note: Chilling Scream cancels Blood Frenzy at once, letting Briar take back control of her movement.
Blood Frenzy into Head Rush lands a stun on arrival, so Sylas has little time to react.

tips.text: Do not fight Talon in the open early; his burst can kill you before Crimson Curse heals much.
Use Head Rush on Talon so he is stunned and cannot jump away or finish his combo.
Talon is weak once Shadow Assault is down; look for your fight or Certain Death then.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall to knock Talon into it for big damage and a long stun.

comboRefs.note: Blood Frenzy into Head Rush closes fast and lands the stun on Talon before he can leap away.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Viego to stun him before he can start a trade, then fight right away while he cannot act.
Hold Chilling Scream until it is fully charged and aim it so Viego is knocked back into a wall; that stuns him and deals big damage.
Use Chilling Scream when Viego charges Spectral Maw; the charge cannot be interrupted, but the scream still gives you damage reduction and healing.
Keep Certain Death for when Viego is low on health; he will not escape you, and his Heartbreaker ending a possession will not save him.
Use Head Rush on Xin Zhao to stun him as he starts his combo; a stunned Xin Zhao can't finish Three Talon Strike.
Charge Chilling Scream fully near a wall when Xin Zhao is in front of it; he is knocked back, takes heavy damage and is stunned.
Chilling Scream gives you damage reduction and heals you, so use it when Xin Zhao dives in with Audacious Charge.
Stay spread out when Crescent Guard comes; it knocks you back and stuns you unless you are Challenged.

comboRefs.note: Chilling Scream cancels Blood Frenzy at once, giving damage reduction and healing against his attacks.

tips.text: Dodge Charm by staying behind minions; if it lands, Briar can't trade well.
Head Rush onto Ahri when Charm is on cooldown; she has little to stop you.
Look to fight Ahri when Spirit Rush is down; she is much easier to catch then.
Charge Chilling Scream fully to slow Ahri and knock her back if she is near a wall.
Leap onto Akali with Head Rush to stun her, then fight right away. She is weak once caught.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Akali is near a wall; it knocks her back and stuns her if she hits it.
Akali's smoke hides her, but area damage still hits her inside it. Use Chilling Scream on the smoke to reveal her.
Use Certain Death to reach Akali when she retreats, since the kicked gemstone flies a very long way. It marks her as your prey.
Dodge Flash Frost by staying out of its line; getting hit and then stunned at the end of its range loses you the trade.
Wait for Anivia to use Crystallize, then jump in with Head Rush when it is on cooldown.
Use Head Rush on Anivia to stun her, then stay on her; she has little to do once you are close.
Her egg comes back with full health, so gather the damage to finish it, or fight it in the open.

comboRefs.note: Dash-casting Head Rush stuns Anivia sooner on arrival, giving her less time to react.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Aurora to stun her, then fight. She cannot walk away while stunned, so that is your window to trade.
Aurora is hard to pin down once she goes invisible with Across the Veil. Wait until it is spent before you jump in with Blood Frenzy.
Do not charge Chilling Scream in the open when Aurora can slow you. Save the full charge for when a wall is behind her, so she is stunned.
Use Certain Death to reach Aurora when she tries to leave. Between Worlds can still block your escape, so make sure you are ready to fight when you land.
Close the gap with Head Rush on Cassiopeia, which stuns her. Then fight hard while she can't cast.
Don't leap with Blood Frenzy into Miasma clouds; you would be grounded and slowed. Dash around them instead.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze, so you are only slowed rather than stunned.
Use Chilling Scream at full charge when she is near a wall; it knocks her back and stuns her if she hits the wall.
Use Certain Death at level 6 to reach Cassiopeia from far away; she has trouble escaping once you are on her.

comboRefs.note: Casting Head Rush mid-dash stuns Cassiopeia sooner, cutting her time to react with her spells.
Chilling Scream ends Blood Frenzy, so Briar can stop chasing and heal against Cassiopeia's poison.

tips.text: Save Head Rush until Fizz has used Playful; while he is balanced on his trident, he can't be targeted.
Stun Fizz with Head Rush, then trade at once. He is slippery otherwise, so bait his Playful first.
Walk out of the way of Chum the Waters, or break its line. The fish sticks to the first champion it hits, then the shark knocks that champion up.
Use Certain Death to reach Fizz when he is cornered, but expect him to hop away with Playful first.

comboRefs.note: Dash-casting Head Rush stuns Fizz sooner, before he can answer with Playful.
Chilling Scream ends the forced attacking, so she can stop chasing Fizz and heal.

tips.text: Wait for Void Shift to drop before you jump in. Bait out a Call of the Void or poke him first.
Sidestep Call of the Void. It silences, and a silence stops your Chilling Scream and Head Rush.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions. When they die, it spreads to you.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage while his Nether Grasp is coming. Stay out of the zone it leaves behind.
Close the gap with Head Rush on Orianna; the stun stops her from using the Ball for a moment, so follow with your attacks.
Don't chase through the slowing field from Command: Dissonance; wait for it to fade before you go in.
Watch where the Ball sits. Orianna can only act around it, so approach from the side away from it.
Stay out of range of Command: Shockwave when Orianna's Ball is near you; it stuns you and pulls you in.
Use Chilling Scream to heal and take less damage while Orianna pokes you, then release it when she is close.

comboRefs.note: Dash-casting Head Rush stuns Orianna sooner, so she has less time to react to Briar's engage.

tips.text: Dodge Overload by stepping out of its narrow line. It is the main way Ryze hurts you from range.
Leap in with Head Rush when Rune Prison is on cooldown. The stun lets you start a trade safely.
Use Chilling Scream when Ryze is near a wall. Fully charged, it knocks him into it for big damage and a stun.
Stop Ryze's Realm Warp by stunning him while the portal charges. Head Rush does that.
Flux marks on you make Ryze hit harder. Avoid staying near the enemy once Spell Flux lands.
Use Blood Frenzy to jump onto Sylas, then land Head Rush to stun him so he can't lash back at you.
Charge Chilling Scream fully when Sylas is near a wall; the knockback slams him into it for big damage and a long stun.
Save Certain Death for when Sylas has used his dash and chains. Then he has little way to escape you.
Stay out of Chain Lash range while waiting for your cooldowns, since it slows you and bursts after a short delay.
Chilling Scream gives damage reduction and healing while you charge it. Use it to survive his burst, though it ends your Blood Frenzy.
Look for Head Rush on Twisted Fate when his Pick a Card is on cooldown. The stun lets you close in and trade.
Twisted Fate's Gold Card stuns when he is about to be hit. Do not run at him while it is selected.
Fully charge Chilling Scream near a wall when Twisted Fate is in front of it. The knockback into the wall stuns him and deals big damage.
Twisted Fate can teleport with Destiny. Fight him after he uses it, and be ready to follow up with Certain Death when he is far from his allies.
Stay out of Viktor's Hextech Ray range early; then use Head Rush to close in and stun him.
Do not stand in Gravity Field after jumping in; if you stay inside, you get stunned.
Look for the moment Viktor has used Gravity Field, then dive; he has fewer ways to stop you.
Use Certain Death to reach Viktor from far away; it clears crowd control while you wind up.

comboRefs.note: Dashing in with Q right after W closes on Viktor fast and stuns him before he can set up his spells.

tips.text: Use Head Rush on Yasuo when he walks up to last-hit; the stun gives you free damage.
Don't cast Chilling Scream or Certain Death into Wind Wall; wait for it to fade first.
Push Yasuo into a wall with a fully charged Chilling Scream for a big hit and a long stun.
Don't get knocked up by Yasuo's whirlwind in a fight; Last Breath lets him follow up. Stay out of line when he has two stacks of Steel Tempest.
Use Head Rush on Yone when he steps up to trade; the stun lets you hit him with a full round of attacks and bleeds.
Charge Chilling Scream when Yone dives on you; it cuts damage you take and heals you. Release it to slow him as you walk away.
Fire Chilling Scream with a wall behind Yone, fully charged, to knock him into it for a long stun and big damage.
Wait for Yone to use Fate Sealed before you commit. Then Chilling Scream ends your frenzy if you need to stop chasing and defend.
Chase him with Blood Frenzy for the speed boost, but expect Spirit Cleave to give him a shield when you land on him.
Use Certain Death to reach Yone if he is out of reach. At level 6 it pins him as your prey, so he cannot easily run from you.

comboRefs.note: Dashing in with Head Rush gets the stun on Yone fast, before he can react with his dashes.

tips.text: Stay close to Zed when Blood Frenzy runs out; Head Rush stuns him and lets you hit him before he can use his shadows.
Hold Chilling Scream for when Zed dives in; it cuts the damage you take and heals you while you charge, and a full charge knocks him back.
Use Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy when Death Mark is on you, so you stop chasing and can step back.
Charge Chilling Scream toward a wall before Zed reaches you; a fully charged scream that slams him into terrain stuns him.
Trade when Zed has spent his shadow; his Razor Shuriken and slow then have less behind them, and your bleed heals you back.

comboRefs.note: Dash-cast Head Rush stuns Zed on arrival, so he has less time to react with his shadow tools.
